name: GlcNAc
aliases: N-Acetylglutamine, Aceglutamide, 2-acetamido-4-carbamoyl-butanoic acid, 4-carbamoyl-2-acetamidobutanoic acid, Aceglutamid, Aceglutamide [INN], Acetylglutamine, alpha-N-Acetyl-L-glutamine
summary: Aceglutamide (brand name Neuramina), or aceglutamide aluminium (brand name Glumal), also known as acetylglutamine, is a psychostimulant, nootropic, and antiulcer agent that is marketed in Spain and Japan. It is an acetylated form of the amino acid L-glutamine, the precursor of glutamate in the body and brain. Aceglutamide functions as a prodrug to glutamine with improved potency and stability.
